==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I had another lucid dream, but it was triggered differently from the last two days. I encountered the spirit of my friend Jarrod at a party. This made me immediately aware that I was in a dream. With control over the dreamscape, I went on a superhero rooftop adventure. Fighting alongside me were two, cat themed, superheroines in black leather. There was a hostage situation at a gas station. I tried to intervene but there were too many ninjas. In order to save the hostage, I had to go back in time and teleport them to safety.
